routes_v5.use: tune = calibration/development (map fitting only); held_out = evaluation, never used to pick an artifact, layer, threshold or map

chat_goldens.gate: min_right 0.9 and no wrong case in a critical flow (#11106)
chat_goldens.use: held-out product evaluation only; no map or artifact is fitted on it

fixed_conditions.request_shape: the router as shipped at router_revision: staged routing default for a Clef-first judge, split side requests
fixed_conditions.answer_bank: compiled into the router at router_revision
fixed_conditions.product_notes: on (OPENAGENTS_PRODUCT_KB_EMBEDDINGS from the AI Gateway key) for every row, Jev included
fixed_conditions.cache: each Clef row starts a fresh psionic-openai-server, so the exact logit cache is empty; Jev is hosted and uncached on our side
fixed_conditions.device: NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, GCE a3-highgpu-1g spot, us-east5-a (27B Q4 needs 18.1 GB of VRAM; the RTX 4080's 16 GB cannot hold it)

candidates.role: larger standard quantization (issue step 3); the same upstream conversion (.src_sha PRIMARY=0b331204bb13fbd2ca93a64df1956f5b55478ce5) and joint head, so checkpoint and head identity are retained; fits the 52 GiB execution cap with about 25 GiB for activations and KV
retained earlier candidate; generated on the Mac and not on this VM, so not in this run

systems.map: Clef-Flash staged map (inherited; not a 27B map)
27B map fitted on routes-v5 tune, scored on held_out raw and calibrated (ROUTER_EVAL_PUBLISH=1)
27B map fitted on routes-v5 tune, scored on held_out raw and calibrated

metrics: route accuracy (routes-v5 per split; chat-goldens route right)
prepared-answer selection (answer top right) and served answer (chat-goldens Pass / right ignoring time)
abstention / no-match (tier model or clarify where a canned answer was expected, and canned precision)
calibration (route top p p10/p50/p90; fitted-map held-out scores)
judge latency p50/p90; judge-only results kept apart from complete product results
VRAM after load and after the run
decision_rule: Jev stays first unless a candidate meets the product's speed (2 s judge budget) and accuracy gates, critical errors included; a smaller BF16 logit difference alone is not success. Failed candidates and their results are retained.
